children: SOBR Safe terminated its Agreement and Plan of Merger and Reorganization with Clean World Ventures effective September 17, 2026, via a Mutual Termination Agreement and Release. The parties agreed to mutually release related claims while continuing to abide by their existing NDA. SOBR Safe will also withdraw its Form S-4 registration statement tied to the proposed transaction. No termination fees were disclosed.
